children.name: text
children: The Contractor may agree the amount of the addition to or deduction from the Fee in the Change Estimate and the Contractor shall notify the Consultant of its decision within a reasonable time of receipt of the Change Estimate. Unless the Contractor notifies the Consultant that it agrees the amount of any change to the Fee set out in a Change Estimate, any addition to or deduction from the Fee shall be calculated by the Contractor as a reasonable amount taking into account any Change Estimate and where appropriate the hourly rates set out in {b:Part 3 of Schedule 2} and may be subject to any other adjustment the Contractor considers reasonable in the circumstances.

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise agreed, any payment in respect of any addition to the Fee shall fall due on the next Fee instalment that falls due in accordance with the terms of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: Unless otherwise agreed, any deduction from the Fee as determined by the Contractor shall be deducted from the next Fee instalment which falls due to the Consultant in accordance with the terms of this agreement and if the deduction from the Fee exceeds that Fee instalment, the balance shall be deducted from the amount which would otherwise be due to the Consultant in the following Fee instalment and subsequent Fee instalments. If any shortfall remains following such deductions the Contractor may claim it as a debt from the Consultant.

children.name: text
children: For the avoidance of doubt, the Contractor is entitled at any time to omit any part of the Services and, in the event of such omission, the Contractor shall not be liable to the Consultant for any losses, including loss of profits, as a result of the omission, including in circumstances where the Contractor has carried out the omitted Services themselves or employed an alternative consultant to carry out the omitted Services.

children.name: text
children: The Fee shall be calculated and paid in instalments in accordance with {b:Part 2 of Schedule 2}. If not set out in {b:Part 2 of Schedule 2}, the Fee shall be paid at intervals of not less than one month, beginning one month after the Consultant begins performing the Services.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall submit to the Contractor an invoice for each instalment of Fee, together with any supporting documents that are reasonably necessary to check the invoice. The invoice and supporting documents (if any) shall specify the sum that the Consultant considers will become due on the payment due date in respect of the instalment of the Fee, and the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: Payment shall be due fourteen (14) days after the date which the Contractor receives each invoice.

children.name: text
children: No later than five (5) days after payment becomes due, the Contractor shall notify the Consultant of the sum that the Contractor considers to have been due at the payment due date in respect of the payment and the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: The final date for payment shall be twenty-eight (28) days after the date on which payment becomes due.

children.name: text
children: Subject to {b:clause 11.9} and unless the Contractor has served a notice under {b:clause 11.7}, the Contractor shall pay the Consultant the sum referred to in the notice under {b:clause 11.4} (or, if the Contractor has not served notice under {b:clause 11.4}, the sum referred to in the invoice referred to in {b:clause 11.2}) (in this {b:clause 11}, the "{b:notified sum}") on or before the final date for payment of each invoice.

children.name: text
children: Not less than one (1) day before the final date for payment (in this {b:clause 11}, the “{b:prescribed period}”), the Contractor may give the Consultant notice that it intends to pay less than the notified sum (in this {b:clause 11}, a “{b:pay less notice}”). Any pay less notice shall specify:

children.name: text
children: the sum that the payer considers to be due on the date the notice is served; and

children.name: text
children: the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor fails to pay an amount due to the Consultant by the final date for payment and fails to give a pay less notice under {b:clause 11.7}, then the Contractor shall pay interest on the overdue amount at the rate of 2% per annum above the Bank of England's base rate from time to time. Such interest shall accrue on a daily basis from the final date for payment until actual payment of the overdue amount, whether before or after judgment. The Contractor shall pay interest together with the overdue amount. The parties acknowledge that the Contractor's liability under this {b:clause 11.8} is a substantial remedy for the purposes of section 9(1) of the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding {b:clause 11.6} and {b:clause 11.7} and without prejudice to {b:clause 18}, if the Consultant becomes Insolvent after the prescribed period, the Contractor shall not be required to pay the notified sum on or before the final date for payment and shall not be required to make any further payment to the Consultant until the performance of the Consultant's obligations under this agreement have been completed which, for the avoidance of doubt, shall be at the end of the liability period applicable to this agreement (as defined at {b:clause 26}).

children.name: text
children: Where the Project is or includes works to a HRB, the Fee is inclusive of all costs associated with or arising from compliance with the Building Safety Legislation and in all dealings with the Building Safety Regulator with regard to building control approval, Controlled Changes, completion certificates and in relation to the Building Safety Regulator decisions, inspections, approvals, requests for information and otherwise.

children.name: text
children: warrants that it has taken out at its own cost with reputable insurers lawfully carrying on such insurance business in the United Kingdom a Professional Indemnity insurance policy with a limit of indemnity of not less than {ProfessionalIndemnity}) in relation to claims or series of claims arising out of one event;

children.name: text
children: provided it remains available generally in the market to the Consultant (and/or members of the Consultant's profession engaged in services of a similar scope, size, nature and complexity as the Consultant) at commercially reasonable rates, shall maintain such insurance until the expiry of twelve years from the date of Practical Completion of the Works as established pursuant to the Building Contract (or such later period as may be required under the Limitation Act 1980 in respect of Section 1 or 2A of the Defective Premises Act 1972 and/or Section 38 of the Building Act 1984); and

children.name: text
children: as and when reasonably requested to do so by the Contractor, shall produce for inspection documentary evidence that such insurance has been effected and/or is being maintained in accordance with this agreement.

children.name: text
children: Such insurance shall cover (inter alia) all the Consultant's liability under this agreement in respect of defects or insufficiency in design, upon customary and usual terms and conditions prevailing for the time being in the insurance market. Such terms and conditions shall not include any term or condition to the effect that the Consultant must discharge any liability before being entitled to recover from the insurers, or any other term or condition which might adversely affect the rights of any person to  recover from the insurers pursuant to the Third Parties (Rights Against Insurers) Act 2010. The Consultant shall not, without the prior approval in writing of the Contractor, settle or compromise with the insurers any claim which the Consultant may have against the insurers and which relates to a claim by the Contractor against the Consultant, or by any act or omission lose or prejudice the Consultant‘s right to make or proceed with such a claim against the insurers. Any increased or additional premium required by insurers by reason of the Consultant’s own claims record or other acts, omissions, matters or things particular to the Consultant shall be deemed to be within commercially reasonable rates.

children.name: text
children: If such insurance ceases to be available generally in the market to the Consultant (and/or members of the Consultant's profession engaged in services of a similar scope, size, nature and complexity as the Consultant) at commercially reasonable rates, the Consultant shall immediately give notice to the Contractor so that the Consultant and the Contractor can discuss the means of best protecting the respective positions of the Contractor and the Consultant in the absence of such insurance. The Consultant shall fully co-operate with any measures reasonably required by the Contractor, including (without limitation) completing any proposals for insurance and associated documents, maintaining such insurance at rates above commercially reasonable rates if the Contractor undertakes in writing to reimburse the Consultant in respect of the net cost of such insurance to the Consultant above commercially reasonable rates or, if the Contractor effects such insurance at rates at or above commercially reasonable rates, reimbursing the Contractor in respect of what the net cost of such insurance to the Contractor would have been at commercially reasonable rates.

children.name: text
children: Within seven (7) days of receiving a written request from the Contractor, the Consultant shall enter into a Collateral Warranty in favour of any Beneficiary identified by the Contractor in the written request.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other term of this agreement the provision of collateral warranties requested pursuant to {b:clause 13.1} shall be a condition precedent to the obligation of the Contractor to pay any sums to the Consultant under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Intellectual Property in all Material shall remain vested in the Consultant. The Consultant agrees to waive, and shall procure that any duly authorised sub-consultants waive, any right to be identified as author of the Material in accordance with section 77 of the Copyright, Designs and Patent Act 1988.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall have an unconditional, irrevocable, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-terminable licence (such licence to remain in full force and effect notwithstanding the completion of the Consultant's obligations or the termination of this agreement or the determination of the Consultant's engagement under this agreement or any dispute under this agreement) to copy and use the Material and to reproduce the  designs and content of them for any purpose relating to the Project, including, without limitation, any of the Permitted Uses. Such licence will carry the right to grant sub-licences and will be transferable to third parties. The licence referred to in this {b:clause 14.2} allows the Contractor to use the Material in connection with any extension of the Project, but not to reproduce the designs contained in the Material in any such extension.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not be liable for any use the Contractor may make of the Material for any purpose other than the purposes for which they were originally prepared and the Permitted Uses.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant will not grant to any third party the right to use any of the Material save under any warranty it is obliged to give under this agreement or as otherwise required to enable it to fulfil its obligations under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant warrants that the Material (except to the extent that duly authorised sub-consultants are used) are the Consultant's own original work and that in any event their use in connection with the Project will not infringe the rights of any third party. The Consultant further warrants that where duly authorised sub-consultants are used their work will be original and will be covered by the licence granted to the Beneficiary under this {b:clause 14}. The Consultant shall indemnify the Contractor against all claims, liabilities and expenses arising out of any claim that use of the Material infringes the rights of any third party.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant agrees on reasonable request at any time and following reasonable prior written notice to give to the Contractor, or those authorised by the Contractor, access to the Material and to provide copies (including copy negatives and CAD disks) of the Material at the Contractor's expense.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may assign the benefit of this agreement:

children.name: text
children: on two occasions to any person; and

children.name: text
children: without counting as an assignment under {b:clause 15.1.1}

children.name: text
children: by way of security to a Funder (including any reassignment on redemption of security); or

children.name: text
children: to and from and Group Company.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall notify the Consultant of any assignment. If the Contractor fails to do this, the assignment shall still be valid.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not contend that any person to whom the benefit of this agreement is assigned under {b:clause 15.1} may not recover any sum under this agreement because that person is an assignee and not a named party to this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant may not assign or transfer its obligations under this agreement to any other person.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not sub-contract the performance of any of the Services without the Contractor's prior written consent. The Consultant shall:

children.name: text
children: be responsible for any services it sub-contracts to a third party as if it had performed those services itself;

children.name: text
children: within seven (7) days of a request from the Contractor provide the Contractor with a complete certified copy of the sub-consultant's appointment which shall be executed as a Deed;

children.name: text
children: within seven (7) days of a written request from the Contractor to do so, deliver deeds of Collateral Warranty to the Contractor in favour of the Contractor and any Beneficiary, duly executed by such sub-consultant, and in the form of the Consultant's Collateral Warranty set out in the Appendix Part A, with only such amendments as the Contractor may require.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may, at any time, suspend performance of all or part of the Services by giving written notice to the Consultant. If the Contractor suspends performance of part of the Services and does not instruct the Consultant to resume performance of those services the Contractor shall not be responsible to the Consultant for loss of profits, loss of fees, loss of chance or other losses. Subject to {b:clause 17.2} the Consultant shall resume performance of the Services as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving a written notice to do so from the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: subject to {b:clause 11.9}, if the Contractor fails to pay in full the notified sum to the Consultant under this agreement by the final date for payment under {b:clause 11.5}; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor has not given a pay less notice complying with {b:clause 11.7}, the Consultant may suspend the performance of any or all of its Services and other obligations under this agreement by giving not less than seven (7) days' notice to the Contractor of its intention to do so and stating the ground or grounds on which it intends to suspend performance.

children.name: text
children: In the event of a suspension in accordance with this agreement, the Contractor shall pay the Consultant a reasonable amount in respect of costs and expenses reasonably incurred by the Consultant as a result of any exercise of its right referred to in {b:clause 16.2} and such payment shall be the Consultant's sole compensation for suspension of its Services and obligations under this agreement

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may terminate the Consultant's engagement under this agreement at any time by giving notice in writing to the Consultant.

children.name: text
children: a suspension of all of the Services in accordance with {b:clause 16.1} continues for a continuous period of six months; and

children.name: text
children: the Contractor does not instruct the Consultant to resume the Services within twenty (20) Business Days of receiving a written notice from the Consultant requiring it to do so, the Consultant may immediately terminate its engagement under this agreement by giving written notice to the Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Either party may immediately terminate the Consultant's engagement under this agreement by giving written notice to the other party if:

children.name: text
children: the other party is in material breach of its obligations under this agreement and fails to remedy that breach within ten (10) Business Days of receiving written notice requiring it to do so; or

children.name: text
children: On termination in accordance with {b:clause 17} the Contractor shall pay the Consultant:

children.name: text
children: any amount properly due for payment under this agreement at the date of termination; and

children.name: text
children: a fair and reasonable proportion of the next instalment of the Fee commensurate with the Services properly performed at the date of termination.

children.name: text
children: If the Consultant's engagement under this agreement is terminated:

children.name: text
children: by the Consultant in accordance with {b:clause 17.2};

children.name: text
children: by the Consultant in accordance with {b:clause 17.3.1}; or

children.name: text
children: by the Consultant in accordance with {b:clause 17.3.2},
the Contractor shall also pay any expenses and disbursements necessarily incurred by the Consultant as a direct result of termination.

children.name: text
children: If the Consultant's engagement under this agreement is terminated by the Contractor in accordance with:

children.name: text
children: the Consultant shall also pay the Contractor the reasonable cost of procuring a replacement professional consultant to carry out any unperformed Services, to the extent that such cost exceeds the Fee (or, where the Fee is yet to be determined, the Contractor's reasonable estimate of the Fee). Any such cost shall be deducted from the amount payable to the Consultant under {b:clause 18.1} and if any shortfall remains following such deduction the Contractor may claim it as a debt due from the Consultant.

children.name: text
children: Payment under {b:clause 18.1} and {b:clause 18.2} (if any) shall be:

children.name: text
children: the Consultant's sole entitlement to compensation for termination of its engagement under this agreement; and

children.name: text
children: claimed by the Consultant as if it was a payment under {b:clause 11}.

children.name: text
children: Except as set out in {b:clause 18.1} and {b:clause 18.2}, the Contractor shall not be liable to the Consultant for:

children.name: text
children: any costs, expenses, disbursements or losses;

children.name: text
children: any loss of profits, loss of fees, loss of chance or other similar losses; or

children.name: text
children: any indirect losses or consequential losses

children.name: text
children: arising out of termination of the Consultant's engagement under this agreement, irrespective of whether the Contractor carries out the remainder of the Services themselves or by the appointment of an alternative consultant.

children.name: text
children: Termination of the Consultant's engagement under this agreement shall not affect any rights, remedies, obligations or liabilities of the parties that have accrued up to the date of termination, including the right to claim damages in respect of any breach of this agreement which existed at or before the date of termination.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall, subject to serving a valid pay less notice, be entitled to deduct, set off, abate, counterclaim or otherwise withhold from any monies due to the Consultant under this agreement any sums which are in the opinion of the Contractor due to the Contractor under any provisions of this agreement or as a result of any breach of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: Save as may be necessary for the performance of the Services, or as required by law, or as the Contractor may allow in writing, the Consultant is to treat as confidential all information relating to this agreement and to the Project, and shall take all reasonable steps to see that the Consultant's employees and agents are bound by and adhere to the same duty of confidentiality.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant warrants that no offence under the Bribery Act 2010 ({b:Act}) has been or will be committed by the Consultant or any person associated with the Consultant, in connection with the procurement or implementation of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: For the purposes of and without derogation from {b:clause 21.1}, an offence is committed under any provision of the Act before such provision is in force, if such offence would have been committed, had such provision then been in force.

children.name: text
children: For the purposes of {b:clause 21.1}, the definition of associated person in section 8 of the Act applies.

children.name: text
children: If at any time the Consultant has knowledge of, or reasonable grounds to suspect the occurrence of, a breach of the warranty in clause 21.1, the Consultant shall promptly notify the Contractor in writing of such matters, or of such grounds for suspicion, and shall co-operate with the Contractor in the investigation of such breach or suspected breach of warranty.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not cause or contribute to any breach by the Contractor of the Building Contract of which relevant extracts have been provided to the Consultant, and any other third party agreements provided by the Contractor to the Consultant, provided that, where the Contractor notifies the Consultant of any other third party agreement after the date of this agreement, the Consultant is not required to act in any way that may increase the Consultant's liability in excess of that which was reasonably foreseeable at the date of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: This agreement is not intended to confer any rights on any third party pursuant to the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of this agreement either party may refer a dispute arising under this agreement to adjudication at any time under Part I of the Scheme for Construction Contracts (England and Wales) Regulations, which Part shall take effect as if it was incorporated into this clause.

children.name: text
children: The adjudicator shall be nominated by the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors.

children.name: text
children: Any notice to be given by either party under this agreement shall be sufficiently served if sent by hand or by post to the registered office or if there is none the last known address of the party to be served. Any notice sent by hand shall be deemed to be served on the date of delivery provided that if any notice sent by hand is sent after 5:00 p.m. on any day it shall be deemed to be served on the next Business Day. Any notice sent by post shall be deemed to have been duly served at the expiration of 48 hours after the time of posting if the end of that period falls before 5:00 p.m. on a Business Day and otherwise on the next Business Day.

children.name: text
children: Save to the extent the Sub-Consultant has a longer period of liability (whether to the Contractor or any third party) under the Limitation Act 1980 in respect of Section 1 or 2A of the Defective Premises Act 1972 and/or Section 38 of the Building Act 1984 (in which case the Consultant's liability under this agreement shall be extended to an equivalent period in respect of any such matter), the Parties agree that the Consultant's liability under this agreement shall continue and shall not cease until the expiry of 12 years after the date of Practical Completion and on that date such obligations and liabilities shall cease, but without prejudice to any matter, claim or dispute in relation to which legal proceedings were commenced prior to the expiry of such date.

children.name: text
children: This agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims) shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England.

children.name: text
children: Each party irrevocably agrees that the courts of England shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this agreement or its subject matter or formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of this agreement, the Consultant agrees that it shall not be entitled to contend in defence of proceedings under this agreement or otherwise that its liability to the Contractor is reduced or affected by virtue of the fact that the Contractor has suffered no loss, but such agreement by the Consultant only applies in so far as such defence could be put forward on the basis that the Contractor is not the owner of the Site and/or the Works.

children.name: text
children: This agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which when executed and delivered shall constitute a duplicate original, but all the counterparts shall together constitute the one agreement.

children.name: text
children: No counterpart shall be effective until each party has executed and delivered at least one counterpart.

children.name: text
children: {b:THIS DOCUMENT} is executed as a deed by the Contractor and the Consultant and delivered on the date stated at the beginning of this Deed.
